newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso dips, but seen firm through April.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso dips, but seen firm through April.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 2 Reuter - Colombia's peso fell 20 centavos to 1,062.5 to the dollar in trade dominated by industry and financial institutions, interbank traders said.
"Central bank forecasts on foreign reserves in 1997 fueled expectations that the dollar will remain steady or even fall in April," one Medellin trader said.
A report presented by the central bank board of directors to Congress Wednesday predicted net foreign reserves would grow a further $756 million this year to a total $10.64 billion by the year end.
Dealers reported 273 trades worth a total $116 million, still below the daily average of $180 million.
The peso opened at 1,063.1 and hit an intraday high of 1,061.4.
